message:
Blog post slugs now keep the base letter of accented characters, so "Crème brûlée recipes" becomes `creme-brulee-recipes`. `npm test` passes, including `test/blog-slug.test.js`.

The fix is in `src/blog/slug.js`. `postSlug` now strips accent marks from the title before passing it to the vendored `slugify`. I left `vendor/` alone, as you asked.

Shop product URLs (`src/shop/product-url.js`) call the vendored `slugify` directly. They will still drop accented letters. Fixing that would take either the same change there or an upgrade to the vendored library by the platform team.
